name: KORCHIP Inc.
summary: Based in South Korea, KORCHIP Inc. is an energy storage technology firm primarily involved in the research, development, and manufacturing of secondary batteries. The company additionally distributes various electronic components. Its offerings are exported worldwide, reaching markets across Europe, China, the Americas, Japan, India, and Southeast Asia. KORCHIP Inc. was founded in 1990 and maintains its corporate headquarters in Anyang-si, South Korea.
